BLOCKED: E12-2 needs a fourth host method that the brief does not allow, so I built nothing, committed nothing and ran no gate. Report: /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/e12-2.md.report.md

- **Why it stops:** in an `f"…"` literal, the compiler pass that picks text types (`text_tiers`) wraps some of each hole's values in a method call. That wrapping is `text_tiers::wrap_hole`. It walks the hole in Rust, changing it in place, and gives each new node a fresh id (`NodeId::fresh`). So it cannot move in this slice. The Rust adapter `crate::emit::literal_expressions` has twelve callers that hold only `&Parsed`, so no existing host can do the wrapping for it. The brief names only `hole`, `cached_holes` and `cached_kept_calls`.
- **Proposed fix (in `Needs:`):**
  - One new trait, `EmitHolesHost`, in `emit_holes.nika`, implemented in Rust for `Parsed`.
  - It has the three named methods, with `hole` also returning the parser's error text.
  - The fourth method is `wrapped_hole(at, hole) -> Expr?`: the hole with the wrapping applied, or `null` where nothing is wrapped.
  - The rest of the hole logic needs no host. On the emit side, `names_read` moves to Nikaia using `EmitState.template_holes`, `EmitState.hole_wraps` and the existing `EmitHost.wrap_hole`, so `EmitHost` gains nothing.
- **Next:** approve the fourth method or name another way, then re-brief. Step 2 depends on step 1, so it waits too.
- **Disk:** `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 3.3G, over the 2G limit. I left it because nothing in this run created entries and 19G of the disk is free. Nothing was freed.
